prompts.style:
Use case: style-transfer. Restyle IMAGE 1, the ORIGINAL Blade Dancer, to match the polished 2D Japanese anime LINEWORK AND COLOR RENDERING of IMAGE 2, the newly approved Sword Master.

IMAGE 1 is the sole CHARACTER AND DESIGN source. Preserve the original character's face identity, expression, eyes, skin tone, deep navy long high ponytail, exact costume layout and black/navy/lavender/silver color relationships, arm bands, cuffs, buckles, flowing fabric panels, boots, both original STRAIGHT silver swords, pose with one arm overhead and one arm extended, one lifted bent knee and one extended supporting leg, camera angle, body proportions and composition. The user has reverted to this original design; do not introduce any details from later rejected redesigns. Do not add a face veil, change the hair to short loose hair, substitute curved sabers, or change the costume construction. Preserve the original game-character presentation, without exaggerating anatomy or adding any emphasis.

IMAGE 2 is only the APPROVED CURRENT RENDERING STYLE: controlled clean continuous contours, delicate facial lines, slightly stronger outer contours than interior structure, natural coherent form shading with restrained material rendering. Use clear broad hair shapes and connected highlights following the hair flow; no repeated light-dark stripe artifacts or dense fine strands. Give cloth a moderate number of functional folds, neither dense tiny wrinkles nor featureless rubber surfaces. Render the steel blades with clear straight edges and simple planar highlights; no gratuitous gloss, etched decoration or extra details.

The character should visibly belong to the same 2D anime game illustration set as IMAGE 2, while remaining recognizably the ORIGINAL Blade Dancer of IMAGE 1. Maintain her existing expression and head/body alignment and preserve anatomical naturalness of both hands. Do not copy the male face, red cape, leather clothes, central longsword pose or palette from image 2. No new objects or effects. No crosshatching, grid patterns, diagonal bands, grain, paper texture, blurry upscaling, painterly realism or 3D render shading. Natural shading, no forced fixed two-tone palette.

One full-body character on a genuinely TRANSPARENT square canvas, requested 2048x2048. All original swords, raised hand, long hair, fabric and boots fully within the image, with minimal top/bottom clearance. No backdrop, ground shadow, text, label, frame or watermark. This is a faithful style update, not a redesign.
